name: Spread the Rot
description: Prefers the enemy carrying the most ailment stacks.

name: Focus the Boss
description: Always targets a summoned boss over trash.

name: Break the Guard
description: Prefers enemies with an active guard or ward.

name: Press the Crit Window
description: Holds a big cooldown while a crit window is open.

name: Hold for the Pack
description: Saves area skills until at least three enemies are alive.

name: Burst the Elite
description: Prioritises elites while they are above half health.

name: Mend First
description: Casts a guard or heal immediately below 45% health.

name: Ward Before Wounds
description: Refreshes ward when it falls under 20%.

name: Channel the Big Cast
description: Starts long casts first when the enemy is not about to die.

name: Cleanse Exposure
description: Spends a cleanse effect before exposure stacks reach three.
